author: feral-core
description: Anthropic-style GUI computer use primitives: screenshot, mouse clicks, typing, key combos, scrolling, and window management. Supports Retina/HiDPI scaling automatically.

endpoints.description: Capture the current screen. Returns a base64 JPEG image resized to max 1920px width. Reports the DPI scale factor.
endpoints.returns_description: Base64-encoded JPEG screenshot, image format, and DPI scale factor

endpoints.description: Left-click at the given (x, y) coordinates. Coordinates are in screenshot-space and automatically adjusted for DPI scaling.
Double-click at the given (x, y) coordinates.
Right-click at the given (x, y) coordinates.
Move the mouse cursor to (x, y) without clicking.
Type a text string. Handles Unicode via pyperclip+Cmd/Ctrl+V fallback for non-ASCII characters.
Press a key combination. Use '+' to separate modifiers (e.g. 'cmd+c', 'ctrl+shift+t', 'enter', 'tab').
Scroll at a given position. If x/y are omitted, scrolls at the current cursor position.
Return the current mouse cursor position.
endpoints.returns_description: Current x, y coordinates and DPI scale

endpoints.description: List the on-screen windows. Each entry has app, title, x, y, width, height, pid and window_id. app_frontmost is fresh AX foreground-PID evidence; focused is a uniquely verified actual AXFocusedWindow mapped to that row. app_frontmost_known/focused_known distinguish unavailable evidence. Multiple windows in one foreground app are not all focused. Backed by CoreGraphics with a System Events fallback; if neither can enumerate, the call FAILS with the real reason instead of reporting an empty desktop.
endpoints.returns_description: windows (array of {app, title, x, y, width, height, pid, window_id, focused, focused_known, app_frontmost, app_frontmost_known}), count, source, and the per-backend attempt log

endpoints.description: Bring an observed window to the front by its exact title or by a unique application name. Ambiguous matches refuse; use a fresh window_list title. Resolves a unique actual AX window by observed title or exact bounds in the same PID, so CG and AX title differences are not guessed. When several windows share bounds and CG/AX titles differ, supply optional window_ax_title copied exactly from fresh macos_ax__list_windows. The tool requires a unique observed CG-to-AX title prefix in both inventories plus matching bounds; it never constructs a suffix or ignores ambiguity. Uses exact app/window AX handles and verifies fresh foreground PID plus the same AXFocusedWindow after requesting focus. An accepted request alone is not success. App-only focus for a uniquely running app verifies PID only and reports window_focus_verified=false; it never launches a missing app. Unknown/refused focus must not be followed by global keys or text. A successful receipt is a point-in-time observation; verify foreground again immediately before any global input.

params.name: title
params.description: Window title or application name to focus

params.name: window_ax_title
params.description: macOS only: exact observed AX window title from a fresh macos_ax__list_windows for the same intended CG window/PID. Resolves differing CG/AX titles with overlapping bounds only when observed title prefixes are unique on both sides. Never invent app/profile suffixes.

endpoints.returns_description: Verified foreground PID, selected window_id and actual observed AX title/identity_match when available; foreground_verified and window_focus_verified explicitly identify the verified outcome
